title: Police kill gun-wielding man
article: A Maynard, Ont., man was shot and killed by the Ontario Provincial Police Monday morning after he arrived armed with a gun and opened fire into the home of his former common-law wife. Fred Kirkey, 33, died the same morning he was to start serving a five- month jail sentence for drunk driving.
According to witnesses, Kirkey sped into the driveway of Loretta Sayeau, who ended their relationship a year ago.

An eyewitness, who lives on the farm where the shooting occurred, said Kirkey crashed his car into the back of the new boyfriend's vehicle. He then jumped out of the car with a gun in his hands and fired at least three shots in the direction of the house.

The witness said that Kirkey fell to the ground after either shooting himself or being hit by a bullet ricocheting off the house. After a 911 call at 9:30 a.m., the small town's deputy fire chief, Lorne Dougherty, arrived at the scene to find Kirkey wounded but still wielding his gun.
Police arrived and ordered Mr. Kirkey to drop his gun, the eyewitness said. Instead, he fired it. Police then shot him.
